summary: [correctness] HOOKS_INSTALL_INCOMPLETE covers the second hook file only. `write_pre_commit_script` failing after both hook files were written is still WRITE_FAILED (gate.rs, `if writes_script`), with the files installed and no read-first next; the same stop one step later takes the other code. Make the script write the third step of the same INCOMPLETE (claude or codex outcome Installed), keep WRITE_FAILED only for a first write that kept nothing. Also the brief table says not retryable, and a repeat of install-hooks does finish the install (observed: the second run without the seam installed the codex file); not retryable is the conservative registry value and matches the brief, so no change asked.
